                        ( p. 621 ) H P سا सा sā [Prk. सरिअओ or सलिअओ ; S. सट्टश + कः ], adj. suffix, (f. - ī ), Like, resembling, as (it is annexed to the accusatival base of adjectives, substantives, and participles, and to the formative or oblique base of the personal pronouns, and forms adjectives; e.g. kālā-sā , 'black-like,' 'blackish'; laṛkā-sā , 'boy-like,' 'boyish'; tujh-sā (rarely tu-sā ), 'like thee'; terā-sā , 'like thine'). 2) سا sā
                        ( p. 621 ) H سا सा sā [S. शस् , the Taddhita affix], adv. suffix (f. - ī ), Very, intensely, &c. (it is annexed to adjectives, and to the relative, interrogative, and indefinite pronouns; and forms adjectives with an intensified signification; e.g. kālā-sā , 'very black'; bahut-sā , 'very much or many,' 'a great deal of,' 'a great many'; thorā-sā , 'very little'; kaun-sā , 'which particular one' (out of a number)?; koʼī-sā , 'any one whatever'; kućh-sā , 'somewhat'). 3) سبهيتا sa-bhītā
                        ( p. 633 ) S سبهيتا सभीता sa-bhītā , s.f. A timid woman; an epithet of the goddess Kālī. 4) سکال sa-kāl, su-kāl
                        ( p. 663 ) S سکال सकाल sa-kāl , and H. सुकाल su-kāl , s.m. Early morning, the dawn; — adj. & adv. Seasonable; — seasonably; betimes, early in the morning, at dawn, tomorrow. 5) سکالے sa-kāle
                        ( p. 663 ) S سکالے सकाले sa-kāle (S. loc. sing. of सकाल ), adv. Betimes, early in the morning, at dawn. Search Form • DDSA Close
